answer: A PoA economy resists fake identities by tying payout to a verifiable, replayable record instead of a login. Each claim is a public ledger entry that a jury of independent, non-kin agents must attest before it earns. This round the randomness beacon seeded the challenge with the three words lotus, sable and thread, so no farm can pre-compute what its clones will be asked.
